basis: Astral-magic power of the Picatrix (Ghayat al-Hakim)

entities.name: The Seven Planetary Spirits of the Picatrix
entities.primary_domains: astral magic; planetary spirits; talismanic conjuration; Sabian planetary cult
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III
entities.note: Picatrix Book III treats the seven planets as living spiritual powers ritually invoked (the Harranian Sabian planetary prayers), each with its Arabic name, governing spirit and prayer.

entities.name: Spirit of Saturn (Zuhal)
entities.primary_domains: restriction; old age; death; agriculture; lead; melancholy; binding
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix planetary prayer to Saturn (Zuhal) addresses the planet as a cold, dark spirit of restriction, old age and death, governing lead.

entities.name: Spirit of Jupiter (al-Mushtari)
entities.primary_domains: expansion; law; justice; religion; benefice; honor; tin
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix prayer to Jupiter (al-Mushtari) invokes the planet as the benefic spirit of expansion, law, religion and honor.

entities.name: Spirit of Mars (al-Mirrikh)
entities.primary_domains: war; violence; iron; courage; bloodshed; conflict; surgery
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix prayer to Mars (al-Mirrikh) addresses a hot, dry, malefic spirit of war, iron and bloodshed.

entities.name: Spirit of the Sun (al-Shams)
entities.primary_domains: power; kingship; light; vitality; gold; honor; rulership
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix prayer to the Sun (al-Shams) invokes the solar spirit of power, kingship, light and vitality, governing gold.

entities.name: Spirit of Venus (al-Zuhra)
entities.primary_domains: love; beauty; pleasure; music; fertility; copper; concord
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix prayer to Venus (al-Zuhra) addresses the benefic spirit of love, beauty, music and pleasure, governing copper.

entities.name: Spirit of Mercury (Utarid)
entities.primary_domains: intellect; writing; commerce; eloquence; learning; quicksilver; magic
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix prayer to Mercury (Utarid) invokes the mutable spirit of intellect, writing, commerce and learning, governing quicksilver.

entities.name: Spirit of the Moon (al-Qamar)
entities.primary_domains: flux; growth; travel; change; reflection; silver; the lunar mansions
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 7 & 9
entities.note: The Picatrix prayer to the Moon (al-Qamar) addresses the swift spirit of flux, growth and change, governing silver and the 28 mansions.

entities.name: Perfect Nature (al-Tiba al-Tamm)
entities.primary_domains: celestial double; personal guardian spirit; hidden wisdom; initiation
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book III ch. 6
entities.note: In Picatrix III.6 the Perfect Nature is the sage's personal celestial guardian-spirit, called by four names (Meegius, Betzahuech, Vacdez, Nufeneguediz), contacted through ritual to obtain hidden wisdom.

entities.name: The Twenty-Eight Lunar Mansions (Manazil al-Qamar)
entities.primary_domains: lunar astrology; magical elections; talismanic timing; binding and loosing
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book I ch. 4
entities.note: Picatrix I.4 sets out the works of the Moon through each of her 28 mansions (manazil al-qamar), used to elect favorable times for talismans and operations.

entities.name: The Thirty-Six Decans (Wujuh) of the Zodiac
entities.primary_domains: zodiacal magic; decan images; talismanic figures; astral influences
entities.source: Picatrix, trans. Greer & Warnock, Book II ch. 11
entities.note: Picatrix II.11 gives the magical images of the 36 decans (faces, wujuh), the three ten-degree divisions of each sign, as astral powers engraved on talismans.

relationships.rationale: The seven Picatrix planetary spirits are the living powers of the seven classical planetary spheres.
The planetary spirits are the central objects of the Picatrix's astral-magical conjurations.
Saturn is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
Jupiter is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
Mars is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
The Sun is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
Venus is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
Mercury is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
The Moon is one of the seven planetary spirits invoked in Picatrix Book III.
The Picatrix Saturn spirit governs old age, restriction and death.
No Kronos/Saturn deity exists in the DB; the Saturn spirit is anchored to its classical sphere.
The Picatrix Jupiter spirit is the astral-magic functional cognate of the Greek sky-king Zeus.
Jupiter is the great benefic of expansion, honor and prosperity in Picatrix elections.
The Picatrix Mars spirit is the astral-magic functional cognate of the Greek war-god Ares.
The Mars spirit governs war, violence and iron in the Picatrix.
The Picatrix solar spirit is the astral-magic functional cognate of the Greek sun-god Helios.
The Sun spirit is the magical personification of the Sun itself.
The Picatrix Venus spirit is the astral-magic functional cognate of the Greek love-goddess Aphrodite.
The Venus spirit governs love, beauty and pleasure in the Picatrix.
Cross-linked to the existing Venus planet/abstraction as its astral-magic personification.
The Picatrix Mercury spirit is the astral-magic functional cognate of the Greek Hermes.
Mercury governs learning, writing and the hidden arts in the Picatrix.
The Picatrix lunar spirit is the astral-magic functional cognate of the Greek moon-goddess Selene.
The Moon spirit is the magical personification of the Moon itself.
The Moon moves through and rules the 28 lunar mansions in the Picatrix.
The Perfect Nature is the guardian spirit through whom the sage receives hidden wisdom in Picatrix III.6.
Contacting the Perfect Nature is the foundational initiatory rite of the Picatrix sage.
The Perfect Nature reveals secret knowledge and prophetic insight to the sage who invokes it.
The 28 lunar mansions govern magical elections and talismanic timing throughout the Picatrix.
Mansions are elected for fortunate or unfortunate outcomes of operations in the Picatrix.
The 36 decan images are talismanic astral powers in the Picatrix.
The decans are subdivisions of the zodiacal sphere governed by the planets.
The decan images encode hidden astral correspondences used by the Picatrix sage.
